sloka: अतुष्टं स्वेषु दारेषु चपलं चलितेन्द्रियम् ।नयन्ति निकृतिप्रज्ञां परदाराः पराभवम् ।। ५.१९.८।।।।
transliteration: atuṣṭaṁ sveṣu dāreṣu capalaṁ calitendriyam ।nayanti nikṛtiprajñāṁ paradārāḥ parābhavam ।। 5.19.8।।।।

translations.english: She was emaciated, absorbed in thought of Rama alone and crying and unable to find the end to her grief.
